title: Adding Some Stuff
description: This mod adds some cool stuff.
body:
Transform your gameplay with a variety of craftable medicines, unique ores, new item recipes, and a handy torch launcher!
_This project was created using MCreator, so you may encounter occasional bugs and lower polish compared to hand-coded mods._

_**THIS MOD FEATURES:**_

**Craftable Medicines:**
Brew and craft several new medicines, each designed to remove a specific negative status effect. Collect ingredients and experiment with recipes to build your custom cures.

**New Recipes for Vanilla Items:**
Tired of rare items with no crafting method? This mod adds recipes for vanilla items that previously lacked them, making progression more achievable.

**Brand New Ores:**
Discover a wide selection of new ores—each ore grants unique effects or serves a special function. Instead of traditional mining, use ore converters to create these special ores, opening up new gameplay strategies.

**Torch Launcher:**
Light up your world with style! The torch launcher lets you quickly place torches from a distance (I literally just wanted to add this for no reason.)

**Additional Info**
No special requirements or dependencies, just have fun!

_**Note:** Created in MCreator, so expect a few rough edges, feedback and bug reports are always welcome!_

Explore, craft, and experiment with new possibilities! If you enjoy expanding on vanilla gameplay with imaginative features and quality-of-life tweaks, this mod is for you.
